George breaks down how he grew three AI-powered fitness apps, Wrestle AI, Brawler, and AdMax, using influencer marketing, paid ads, and strategies tailored to each app’s audience. He explains how partnering with wrestling creator Kaden Henshaw helped Wrestle AI surpass 100,000 downloads, why raw screen recordings and reaction-style videos can work well as ads, and how he evaluates ad performance and customer acquisition costs.

The conversation also covers finding underserved niches, combining influencer marketing with paid acquisition, testing creative variations, and using viral content to support paid advertising. George shares how he approaches onboarding and paywalls, uses content feeds and notifications to improve retention, and interviews users to identify product issues. He also explains why clearly communicating an app’s purpose, features, and value is important for attracting users and keeping them engaged.
